question: Where should the lion-ear ornament be placed above the kalaśas?
premises: A lion-ear ornament is to be made.
Its position is above the kalaśas at the back and front.
inference: One should place a lion-ear ornament above the kalaśas at the back and front.
uncertainties: The exact form and size of the siṃhakarṇaka are not specified.
plain_english: Above the kalaśas, at the back and front, one should make a lion-ear ornament.
